cards.title: Card 2 of 4: Login query built from user input
cards.warning: AeroPatch found a risk that someone could type into the username box and change the database query. This is called SQL injection.
cards.after:
def check_login(conn, username, password):
    # users can log in with a username or an email address
    pw_hash = hash_password(password)
    username = username.split("@")[0]
    c = conn.cursor()
    c.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? AND password_hash = ?", (username, pw_hash))
    return c.fetchone()
cards.scanner_after: No warning on this line after the change.
cards.note: The change applies the same parameter fix as card 1, plus one extra line.
